findings: Seeder not wrapped by exception middleware: AdminSeeder.SeedAsync() executes before app.UseMiddleware<GlobalExceptionMiddleware>() is registered, so any DB failure during seeding surfaces as a raw startup crash rather than a structured error. Intentional fail-fast behavior, but should be documented in the ops runbook.

MedicalRecordsController Location header points to a dead route: POST /api/medical-records returns Created with Location: /api/medical-records/{id}, but no GET handler exists at that path. Medical history is only reachable via GET /api/patients/{id}. In-scope per the brief, but clients following the Location header will receive a 404.

ClinicalRuleStore rule count discrepancy in review criterion: the criterion states 15 seed rules; the design document specifies 17. The implementation correctly follows the design (17 rules: DIA-001–003, INT-001–004, ALG-001/002a/002b/003, LAB-001–003, DLC-001–003). No code change needed; the criterion is wrong.
